### Saul’s Successes
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sauls-successes
Passage: 1 Samuel 14:47-52
Points:
- Saul's early reign displayed genuine dedication to duty as he unified the tribes and fought off surrounding hostile nations.
- Through persistent and difficult warfare, he accomplished the kingly responsibility of protecting and delivering God's people.
- By human standards, Saul seemed successful, impressive in stature, and blessed with a royal household and capable commanders.
- Unlike David, Saul lacked heart faithfulness and the enduring presence of the Lord preserving his ways.
- God measures true success not by outward, visible achievements, but by inward covenant obedience to His will.
